name: xuzao-factory
description: 序造 XuZao — 一单到底的工厂协同管理系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n db,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm:db" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:55432 && npm run dev -w backend" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3001 && npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
